metadata.title: सीपीआई (एम) और कांग्रेस पर बरसे प्रद्योत किशोर | TIPRA Motha lamented CPI (M) And Congress
metadata.description: Kriti Singh Debbarma, the BJP candidate for East Tripura and ‘princess’ of Tripura’s erstwhile Manikya royal family, on Thursday, submitted her nomination paper for the Lok Sabha elections at Ambassa in Dhalai district, 90 km from here. She is preparing for her debutant poll battle at the ST-reserved Lok Sabha constituency. Kriti Debbarma, who is married to Yogeshwar Raj Singh of the erstwhile Kawardha Raj royal family of Chhattisgarh, is the younger daughter of the late Kirit Bikram Kishore Manikya Debbarma, and sister of Tipra Motha Party (TMP) founder Pradyot Kishore Manikya Debbarma.
